scheme_name: Assistance Towards Expenses Incurred for Raising of Funds through NSE’s/ BSE’s SME Exchange Platform
other_conditions: Must have a Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) or MSME registration under the MSMED Act, 2006
Enterprise must be established in Rajasthan
Enterprise must have successfully raised capital through an SME Exchange platform during the scheme’s operative period and file the application within that period
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of successful listing on the SME Exchange platform
Enterprise must follow SEBI guidelines for raising capital through the SME Exchange
Only enterprises engaged in Manufacturing and Services are eligible
Enterprise must be in regular production/commercially active at the time of disbursement; assistance is not released to a closed unit
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time financial support up to ₹15 lakh for expenses incurred in raising equity on NSE/BSE SME exchange platforms.
documents_required: Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) or MSME registration under MSMED Act, 2006
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
